# Nadia Garfunkel

> Entrepreneur and university educator at Albert School in Paris, where she teaches marketing and sales. Founder, operator, brand-builder and educator.

## About

- Has worked across continents in tech startups, schools and non-profit organizations, making tech more accessible for non-technical people.
- Previously led go-to-market for imagi (https://imagilabs.com/) and consulted for the UN-backed Private Sector Humanitarian Alliance.
- Today helps early-stage teams with campaigns and operations, and mentors students through career moves.
- Drawn to work that is inclusive and a little experimental, centered on connecting with people.
- Based in Paris, France.

## Education

- MA, Columbia University
- BA, McGill University

## Languages

- English (American)
- Mandarin Chinese (fluent)
- French (in progress)

## Speaking and teaching

- "The Future of Education": annual competition keynote, Lund University VentureLab
- "Creating a Social Impact Venture": guest lecture, Hyper Island, Stockholm
- "Education Through Play": panel, HolonIQ Global Impact Summit, Stockholm
- Rated 9.6/10 by students at Albert School and 19.4/20 at EPF Engineering School

## Writing

- [Reshaping higher education pedagogy: a perspective from a new generation of educators](https://deepdive.albertschool.com/article/reshaping-higher-education-pedagogy-a-perspective-from-a-new-generation-of-educators)
